fire: The samples were tested again. As part of the review, each lab repeated the analysis.

Some people shave daily. Regardless of the method, the skin needs care afterwards.
The data looked odd. In terms of accuracy, the new sensor did slightly better.
The plan was approved. As part of the deal, the town receives a new park.
Venus is bright tonight. For comparison, Sirius is much fainter.
The forms changed this year. Regardless of your age, you must apply in person.
Ich habe eine Frage. In Bezug auf die Kosten bin ich unsicher.
